name: vacuum_multixact_failsafe_age
description: Multixact age threshold at which VACUUM triggers a failsafe emergency vacuum to prevent multixact ID wraparound outage.
symptoms: Database shutdown due to multixact exhaustion
Failed VACUUM operations under high multixact load
tuning_tips: Set to ~400 million (or less than half of autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age) to ensure timely failsafe vacuum before wraparound risk. Monitor pg_stat_database.datfrozenxid_age and pg_stat_database.datminmxid_age to validate timing.
